summary: Backend: 12/13 pytest passing. All Notes & Folders CRUD work; folder delete detaches notes; search/filter & images/checklist persist; _id excluded; id/created_at/updated_at present. AI summarize endpoint code wiring is correct (request reaches LiteLLM via emergentintegrations and uses anthropic claude-sonnet-4-6) but returns 500 because the Emergent LLM key budget is exhausted: 'OpenAIException - Budget has been exceeded! Current cost: 0.0, Max budget: 0.0'. Frontend: Home, editor (FAB→/note/{id}), autosave, pin, checklist add/remove, toggle drawing (component reveals tool-pen/highlight/eraser/undo/clear + 6 color swatches), Folders screen (list/edit/delete buttons), Settings (system/light/dark all work and apply), and Lock screen ('No passcode set — tap continue' shown, Continue button present) all render and function correctly. Drawing pad red-screens on web preview with 'CanvasKit is not defined' from @shopify/react-native-skia — expected per spec (needs touch device / native build).

critical.issue: Returns 500 'Budget has been exceeded! Current cost: 0.0, Max budget: 0.0' from LiteLLM. Code path is correct (LlmChat with anthropic/claude-sonnet-4-6 via EMERGENT_LLM_KEY) — this is a key/quota issue, not implementation. Main agent should request a fresh Emergent LLM key or verify budget on existing key sk-emergent-96bBf421438D13bD95.

integration_issues.issue: Button (testID ai-summarize) is present and tappable, but backend call will fail with 500 due to LLM budget exceeded — visible in UI once user taps. Once backend AI key is restored, this flow is expected to work.

issues: Drawing pad triggers RN red screen on web preview ('CanvasKit is not defined' from @shopify/react-native-skia SkiaPictureView). This is expected per spec — Skia requires real device. Not a code bug for the APK target. The toggle correctly reveals DrawingPad child controls before the error overlay appears.

react_native_issues.issue: On web, throws 'CanvasKit is not defined'. Consider guarding DrawingPad with Platform.OS !== 'web' or lazy import + fallback to keep web preview clean. Not blocking for Android APK.

action_items: Fix/refresh EMERGENT_LLM_KEY budget so POST /api/ai/summarize returns a real summary string. The endpoint code (server.py:205-229) is correct.
Optional: guard DrawingPad render with Platform.OS !== 'web' (or web fallback) so the web preview does not red-screen when users tap toggle-drawing. Native Android build should work as-is.

Optional: expose stable testIDs for the new-folder modal (folder-name-input, folder-color-{hex}, folder-save-btn) so create/edit-folder can be UI-tested end-to-end. Currently only folders-add / folder-edit-{id} / folder-del-{id} are exposed; the create/edit form internals were not discoverable in this run.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py PUT /api/notes/{id}: builds update_data from non-None fields only — correct. But empty string title ('') will overwrite existing title because '' is not None. Frontend should avoid sending empty strings on initial autosave races (low risk).
DrawingPad on web throws inside @shopify/react-native-skia; consider Platform-gated render.
_id is properly stripped via projection {'_id': 0} on all reads — good.

rca_of_issue: AI Summarize 500: emergentintegrations -> litellm raises BadRequestError 'Budget has been exceeded! Current cost: 0.0, Max budget: 0.0'. This indicates the EMERGENT_LLM_KEY has a max_budget of 0.0 set upstream. Reproduce: curl -X POST $URL/api/ai/summarize -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"text":"hello"}'. Mitigation: rotate/upgrade the Emergent LLM key budget; no code change required.
